fidelityCritique: No mandatory UN-xx claims were supplied; deterministic MH/NG coverage is complete and passed, and screenshots independently corroborate the core loop: node rings, thorn hazards, player current with trail, and HUD (SIGNAL NODES 1/3→2/3, SCORE 100→200, STORM PRESSURE bar with numeric value).

Screenshot 1 shows the tutorial prompt 'Glide into a node ring and press SPACE to attune the signal' and screenshot 3 shows an in-ring 'PRESS SPACE' prompt near a node, consistent with player-driven attunement rather than idle progression.

Storm pressure visibly depletes (98 → 78 → 83 after node restore) and thorn speed escalation is machine-verified via hazard_speed_up events (70→196 in failure scenario), satisfying meaningful pressure escalation.
Art direction is coherent: dark teal bioluminescent palette, glowing node cores, dashed attunement rings, circuit-vein background, distinct red thorn hazards — no gray placeholder boxes.

Minor polish gaps: the player's trail is faint, node-activated 'permanent garden illumination' is not clearly distinguishable between screenshots, and the thorn orbs read as generic spiky shapes rather than botanical hazards.
critique: Visuals are cohesive and luminous: dark teal field, glowing amber nodes with dashed rings, red thorn hazards, drifting motes and circuit veins — clearly above generic flat-shape baseline.
HUD is readable and non-obstructive: node pips with 1/3→2/3 counter, big centered score, BEST, and a labeled STORM PRESSURE bar with numeric value; central play area stays clear.

Cause-and-effect is visible across frames: score +100 and node pips fill on activation, pressure bar refills (78→83) after node 2, and hazard_speed_up telemetry confirms escalating thorn speed (70→91 during the winning run).
Fun proxy is decent but the winning run's 11s duration and the faint player trail suggest the challenge may be light; tension comes mostly from the pressure timer.
Performance is excellent: steady 60-62 fps across all snapshots with no errors or flags.
priorityFixes: Strengthen the player current's luminous trail and activation shockwave so node attunement reads more dramatically in a still frame.
Make activated-node garden illumination (brightened circuit veins) more pronounced so world-state change from each activation is unmistakable.
Increase mid-run challenge (e.g., faster pressure drain or denser thorns after node 2) so a successful run approaches the 1-2 minute tension target rather than ~11 seconds.
